xar_cc_remove_selected_trait_conflicts_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:xar_cc_candidate_trait = trait:lustful }
		xar_cc_remove_selected_trait_effect = { TRAIT = trait:chaste }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:xar_cc_candidate_trait = trait:chaste }

	}
